raw_tokens.value: Dark Tapestry Mystery ~ Wings of Darkness

As a swift action, you can manifest a set of translucent, inky wings that grant you a fly speed of 60 feet with good maneuverability. You can use these wings for %1 minutes per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments.|WingsOfDarknessDuration

You can use these wings to fly as if with overland flight once per day. Used in this way, the ability lasts for up to %1 hours, and counts as your total use of this ability for the day.|WingsOfDarknessDuration|PRECLASS:1,Oracle=11
